ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to negotiation-related Opportunity fields once the Opportunity reaches Booking Verification Stage unless the user has override access.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_Fields_Locked__c = TRUE, NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ) ), OR( ISCHANGED(Value_Hypothesis_Scope_Reviewed__c), ISCHANGED(Final_Pricing_Terms_Proposed__c), ISCHANGED(IM_Booked_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fields cannot be edited once the Opportunity reaches a restricted sales stage.
